description: A Starlight docs site, deployed by every merge to main, so each Renovate PR is a deploy. Managers: npm (package.json and package-lock.json) and GitHub Actions. Node 20 is set in the deploy workflow's setup-node, outside Renovate's scope, so no Node manager is on. Lock-file refreshes stay off (the shared default): npm cannot hold a refresh to the 14-day wait.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for the non-major npm updates, so a site gets at most one routine deploy a week from Renovate.
